Chapter 809: Chapter 18 Taiyang Divine Master and Taiyin Sovereign (8000 words, Chapter Two-in-One)_4

As a result,

In recent decades, the worlds occupied by Lin Yuan often suffered interference and even attacks from other Evil Gods.

“Fortunately, my Spirit Will has grown strong enough to simultaneously maintain the combat power of multiple incarnations,”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

An incarnation is not an avatar; maintaining the combat power of an incarnation requires a sufficiently strong Spirit Will.

Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will reached twenty million points, and even before killing a Void Creature Monarch, it had surpassed ten million points, thus he was able to maintain incarnational combat power at a decent level.

...

Additionally, taking advantage of the inner worlds’ Demon Trees that bred physical bodies, even though for a short duration, it couldn’t be as perfect as the Martial Ancestor Golden Body,

But it’s comparable to an Evil God’s physical body; imbuing a thread of Spirit Will to form an incarnation, leveraging home-field advantages, he also fended off the probes of Evil Gods one by one.

Without these incarnations holding fort, relying on Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit alone? Even though the Taiyin Primordial Spirit is powerful, distant water cannot quench near fire; it could only protect a few nearby worlds at most.

“I want to spread the Martial Tao Cultivation System; I must protect the beings within these worlds, and those beings are the food for Evil Gods; those powerful Evil Gods can’t possibly watch their food growing strong.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, with the power exhibited by Taiyin Primordial Spirit, let alone occupying forty worlds, even four hundred or a thousand, no Evil God would dare object.

In the Boundless Void, Evil Gods are the absolute dominions, and among Evil Gods, it’s the survival of the fittest, the strong dominate everything.

But after Lin Yuan occupied worlds, instead of devouring food, he cultivated them, which puzzled and even infuriated many Evil Gods.

This led to many subsequent probings.

“If these Evil Gods know, I am not an Evil God myself but a life nurtured by the worlds, probably it will no longer be probing but a desperate attempt to eradicate.”

Lin Yuan secretly thought.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s Martial Ancestor Golden Body, bred from the Origin Source of Tianqing World, is fundamentally different from those Evil Gods’ life forms,

However, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit originate from Illusory Spirit Bodies, even if utilizing “Illusory Reality” to turn illusion into reality.

But it transcends the physical body, somewhat similar to Evil Gods’ lives, which is why they are thought to be the same ilk of Evil Gods.

“Slowly does it.”

“Just by dragging it out, I will definitely win.”

Lin Yuan was not at all flustered; with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he grew stronger every moment; by buying time, he could securely stand till the end.

“Once my Fusion of Time and Space Rules reach the Sixth Realm, I will become the strongest in the Boundless Void, reaching the level of a Void Secret Realm Founder, then spreading the Martial Tao Cultivation System will be as easy as flipping my hand.”

Lin Yuan quickly thought.

Achieving the Sixth Realm of Fusion of Time and Space Rules, for Lin Yuan’s strength enhancement, is not merely limited to controlling time and space fusion.

Upon reaching Sixth Realm understanding of Fusion of Time and Space Rules, the inner world would also undergo corresponding metamorphic transformation, and the strength of the inner world is closely linked with many of Lin Yuan’s techniques.

Especially, the fifth kind of Physical Body Divine Ability ‘World’.

In short, upon reaching the Sixth Realm of Fusion of Time and Space Rules, Lin Yuan will experience a transformation, an all-around qualitative change.

“If I cannot achieve the Sixth Realm of Fusion of Time and Space Rules this time, after returning, I’ll come back again, after all, it’s only using up one-third of World-Breaking Origin Force.”

Lin Yuan made up his mind, before realizing the rules of Fusion of Time and Space, the Boundless Void and the Main Universe had no significant difference.

Rather, with different timescales, Lin Yuan had more time to comprehend other rules and Secret Techniques.

Moreover, the Void creatures in that Void Secret Realm also greatly benefit Lin Yuan in enhancing his own Spirit Will, another descent is definitely worth it.

…

Ten years later.

Outside a vast world.

Dozens of towering figures stood in the Boundless Void, their gazes coldly towards the world nearby.

“Taiyin Sovereign, why do you cultivate those ants within the world instead of directly devouring them?”

The leading Evil God, a black wolf with three heads, bore a cold expression, aura of a Ninth Stage True Lord enveloping it.

“I have my plans.”

Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit appeared, gazing distantly at the dozens of Evil Gods.

Over three hundred years, as Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit continually occupied one world after another, among Evil Gods, he also gained a title, known as ‘Taiyin Sovereign’.

The titles among Evil Gods often relate to their characteristics and actions; Lin Yuan Taiyang Divine Spirit is called ‘Taiyang Divine Master’ because it controls flames powerful enough to incinerate ordinary True Lords.

And Taiyin Sovereign, is characterized by the chilling aura deployed during actions, coupled with conquering one world after another, hence adorned by the suffix ‘Sovereign’.

“Plans?”

“Whether it’s these worlds or the ants within them, they are all our food; are your plans to cultivate these food sources to oppose us?”

The three-headed black wolf Evil God spoke coldly, if it weren’t for the overwhelming power displayed by the Taiyin Divine Master which makes it uneasy, it would probably have already made a move to suppress.

“This is my business.”

Lin Yuan’s tone was calm; being not an Evil God by nature, he naturally doesn’t need to consider matters from an Evil God’s perspective.

“Your business.”

The three-headed black wolf Evil God sneered, soon a black fog started spreading.

At the same time, chilling cold also began to diffuse enveloping the space outside the world, the two forces continuously clashed, and moments later, the three-headed black wolf Evil God staggered back, full of shock looking at Lin Yuan:

“Taiyin Sovereign, your strength, probably pinnacle right below Ninth Stage Perfection, why protect those ants?”
